## About
We provide Gonstead chiropractic care for the families of Dallas, TX and surrounding communities, from our office on MacArthur Blvd in Lewisville. Our care is gentle and specific, and it is aimed at the cause of your pain rather than only the symptom.
Dr. Chang Hoon Kim studied Biochemistry at North Carolina State University and received his Doctor of Chiropractic from Palmer College of Chiropractic in Davenport, Iowa. While at Palmer, he taught students the Gonstead Method as an executive officer of the Palmer Gonstead Club.
Patients rate us 4.9 from 56 reviews on Google. If you have any questions, please feel free to call us.

## Services
- Gonstead Chiropractic: A system of chiropractic used to analyze and care for the spine in an effective and specific way.
- Extremity Adjusting: Adjusting joints other than the spine, such as TMJ, shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees and feet.
- Back pain and neck pain: Spinal alignment to help relieve muscle strain, neck pain and chronic back pain without invasive procedures.
- Headache: Chiropractic care for migraines and headaches. One reviewer said her chronic headaches have become much less intense.
- Auto-Accident and Work Injury: Dr. Kim has extensive experience caring for auto accident injuries and work related injuries.
- Pregnancy: Gentle care for pregnant women, as part of Dr. Kim's experience with patients from infants to geriatrics.

## FAQ
Q: What is Gonstead chiropractic?
A: It is a system of chiropractic used to analyze and care for the spine in an effective and specific way. Dr. Kim specializes in it.

Q: Can you help after a car accident?
A: Dr. Kim has extensive experience with auto accident injuries. One patient who came in after a car accident said the office was really good at handling his car insurance case.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday, 9am - 5pm. We are closed Thursday, Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where are you located?
A: 2681 MacArthur Blvd, suite 103, Lewisville, TX 75067.
